notes.title: Patch Notes 10/28/22
notes.content:
Multiple Bug Fixes Including
[list]
[*] Fixed bug allowing players to have negative money
[*] Fixed mini-game/tasks hours going into the several hundred
[*] Fixed pretty fun bug where, after losing, players could go to the high score screen and then go back, allowing them to continue the game with an empty van.
[/list]

notes.title: The Van Game is out now!
notes.content:
[h1][b]The Van Game is now available![/b] [/h1]

The release contains a number of bug fixes for the full game as well as the demo. Achievements are also now unlocked for the full game, if you've played a pre-release build you may need to start a new save file in order to unlock all of the achievements.

[h3]What comes next:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [u]Soundtrack![/u]The soundtrack will be coming very soon. Johnathon Orsi did a really amazing job on it and it deserves to be shown off. Unfortunately I made a mistake while uploading it so it may take a few more days. Expect another announcement once it's release.

[*] [u]Mobile Version![/u] A mobile release will be coming out probably within a month, for Apple and Android. I'm currently in a coding bootcamp right now that's pretty intense but it's coming!

[*] [u]Future updates![/u] Bug fixes will be coming as bugs appear. I'm very proud of what The Van Game is but I'm aware of at least a few visual bugs. 
This is my first "real" game with a Steam release. There are a ton of things I would like to add to the game but it will depend on my schedule and how well the game is received.
[/list]

Thank you so much to everyone who played the beta and sent feedback. It's been a lot of work but it's finally out!

Thank you so much to Vicente Nitti, @LimitIV, and Johnathon Orsi! Without you guys this whole game would just be a mess of programmer art. Special thanks to Dennie Thomas for the great "Van Game" voiceover work. And of course an extra special thanks to my lovely wife Kat.

[h2]Thank you for reading and thank you for playing![/h2]
